subject: UmbraHealth: deployment geography attestation & private-connect evidence request
messages:
From: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@umbrahealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@umbrahealth.com, security@umbrahealth.com
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data residency + VPC evidence for procurement

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the overview yesterday. As part of UmbraHealth's procurement security intake we need a compact bundle to confirm the following before legal signs off:

- Physical hosting region for production (we need to confirm EU-only for the workloads we plan to put behind the VPC).
- Whether customer-managed VPC peering / PrivateLink is supported in the eu-west-1 region and an example network diagram showing flow egress boundaries.
- KMS key locality (can keys be restricted to the EU region and do you provide an HSM-backed option?).
- A completed SIG/CAIQ matrix row for the items above or a short SPI checklist we can reference.

Can you reply with the specific evidence files (diagram + short answers) and an estimated timeline? Our SOC/compliance team needs this by next Wednesday to keep the procurement window.

Appreciate it,
Lena Brooks
Head of Vendor Risk — UmbraHealth
Lena.Brooks@umbrahealth.com

--

From: diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@umbrahealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement@umbrahealth.com, security@umbrahealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data residency + VPC evidence for procurement

Hi Lena —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answer up-front: we can host the dedicated tenant in EU-only regions and support customer-managed private connectivity; we’ll attach network evidence and a KMS snapshot. Details below and a proposed delivery plan.

What I will attach in the next email:
- A VPC peering/PrivateLink diagram (eu-west-1) that shows ingress/egress paths and where monitoring/logging lives.
- A short attestation text on regional controls (what we guarantee for EU-only production deployments).
- KMS region screenshot + explanation of HSM integration options.
- The completed SIG extract rows relevant to data residency, connectivity, and key management (UMBRA_SIG_v3_filled.xlsx).

Timeline: I can get the bundle to you by EOD Wednesday (Nov 5). If you need something earlier for redlines, tell me which single artifact to prioritize and I’ll move that up.

Also looping in Neha (Product Security) for the KMS/HSM specifics and Rishi for any contractual language we should prepare for the PO/SLAs.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0124

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@umbrahealth.com>, diego_fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement@umbrahealth.com, security@umbrahealth.com
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data residency + VPC evidence for procurement

Hi Lena — attaching the bundle as requested.

Attachments included: UMBRA_SIG_v3_filled.xlsx; redwood_vpc_peering_diagram.pdf; kms-region-snapshot.png

Key points (short form):
- Regional hosting: production tenant can be pinned to eu-west-1. All compute and persistent storage for that tenant are placed in the EU region; control-plane metadata can be routed via our control plane endpoints but we offer a Private Control Plane option for Private deployments on request.

- Private connectivity: we support customer-managed VPC peering and PrivateLink in eu-west-1. The diagram shows an example peering setup with NAT/Egress endpoints and the recommended routing that prevents EU traffic egress to other regions.

- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys are supported via our KMS integration. Customers can bring keys that are region-restricted (HSM-backed through supported KMS providers). The attached snapshot shows a sample key residing in eu-west-1. For an HSM-backed SLA we offer an add-on and will provide a signed key-binding exhibit if required.

- SIG/CAIQ extract: the spreadsheet highlights rows for data location, networking, and key management. We’ve annotated answers and included links to the runbook pages in the dataroom.

Please review and tell us if Umbra needs a short redline for the PO (Rishi can prepare). Happy to hop on a 20-min call if any of the artifacts need clarification.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Product Security — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

--

From: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@umbrahealth.com>

Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data residency + VPC evidence for procurement

Neha / Diego —

Received the bundle and it looks good. A couple of small asks before we close the intake:

1) Can you confirm in writing (one paragraph) that tethering the tenant to eu-west-1 prevents any scheduled maintenance or failover from moving production compute to non-EU regions? We expect that guarantee in our regs.
2) For the KMS HSM option, can Rishi share the add-on SKU and a short statement of responsibilities for key custody vs. Redwood operational staff?

If you can send those two items by EOD Thursday (Nov 13) we can move the PO to legal review. Otherwise, thanks — the artifacts are sufficient for now and we’ll circle back on contract language.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Lena
Head of Vendor Risk — UmbraHealth
